description: Get a short-lived signed URL to upload (HTTP PUT) a binary file to a path inside a sandbox. Use for non-text payloads too large or binary for tenki_write_file.

content_type.description: MIME type of the upload, e.g. application/octet-stream.

path.description: Destination path in the sandbox, e.g. /home/tenki/data.bin

session_id.description: Sandbox session id (UUID), from tenki_create_sandbox or tenki_list_sandboxes.

name: tenki_get_upload_url
